xcl_timing.method: D3D12 GPU timestamps around batch of K dispatches in one command list; PSO created once; UAV barrier between dispatches; per-dispatch = batch_ms / K
xcl_timing.correctness_checked: s0==55 and all v1 lanes==55 after batch

standalone_timing.method: D3D12 GPU timestamps around batch of K dispatches in one command list; PSO/DXC once; UAV barrier between dispatches; per-dispatch = batch_gpu_ms / K

notes: Program is self-initializing for s0/s1/v1; repeated dispatches in same command list are idempotent for this case.
XCL timestamp frequency reported as 1000000000 Hz (1ns tick); single-dispatch values show 1024ns quantization.
Aggregated batch timing reduces quantization effect.
